description: Prior manifest for AI-DIRAC strict — tracks all physical priors provided to the system

TARGET_DIMS.description: 12 physically meaningful SI dimension patterns used for pruning cross-arity combinations
TARGET_DIMS.ablation_effect: Without TARGET_DIMS, cross-arity combiner would test ALL combinations (O(n^4) explosion for n atoms), most of which would be dimensionally meaningless. Total discoveries would drop significantly due to timeout.

OBSERVABLE_DIMENSIONS.description: SI dimensions for common observable names (posx, mass, pressure, voltage, etc.)
OBSERVABLE_DIMENSIONS.usage: dimension computation for concept and law validation
OBSERVABLE_DIMENSIONS.ablation_effect: Without observable dimensions, concept registration cannot reject dimension-inconsistent concepts. This would allow e.g., posx + temp as a valid concept.

object_types.description: ObjType tags (Particle, Spring, Clock, Fixpoint, Rope, Pulley) — structural only, no physics
object_types.ablation_effect: Required for experiment configuration — without object types, the simulator cannot be parameterized.

geometry_info.description: Manually registered geometry constraints per experiment (e.g., posx=0 in 1D motion)
geometry_info.ablation_effect: Without geometry info, the differential ring has more free variables, making reduction less effective. Laws would still be discovered but the reduction step would be less aggressive.
